    -∑ i, N i * (a i + b i + c i - rbar) * x i

theorem Naheng.Reduction.robust_rate_upper_bound.{u_1} : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (N a b c x : ι → ℝ)
  (rbar limit : ℝ),
  (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ N i) →
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ x i) →
      (∀ (i : ι), x i ≤ 1) →
        Naheng.Reduction.totalSource N a - rbar * Naheng.Reduction.totalAmount N x +
              Naheng.Reduction.rateResidualBudget N a b c rbar ≤
            limit →
          Naheng.Reduction.detailedAmountRate N a b c x ≤ limit

theorem Naheng.Reduction.robust_trajectory_rate_upper_bound.{u_1} : ∀ {ι : Type u_1} [inst : Fintype ι] (N : ι → ℝ)
  (x a b c : ℝ → ι → ℝ) (rbar : ℝ → ℝ) (t limit : ℝ),
  Naheng.Reduction.IsSiteTrajectory x a b c →
    (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ N i) →
      (∀ (i : ι), 0 ≤ x t i) →
        (∀ (i : ι), x t i ≤ 1) →
          Naheng.Reduction.totalSource N (a t) - rbar t * Naheng.Reduction.totalAmount N (x t) +
                Naheng.Reduction.rateResidualBudget N (a t) (b t) (c t) (rbar t) ≤
              limit →
            ∃ qdot, HasDerivAt (fun s => Naheng.Reduction.totalAmount N (x s)) qdot t ∧ qdot ≤ limit
evidence.scope: Real instantaneous finite-site residual budget derived from actual site RHS, upper rate margin and supplied ODE derivative connection; not all-time trajectory, probability, readout, floating-error, physical safety or complete T1/T3
